pr_title: fix: cursor being leaked outside of canvas
pr_body:
fix https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/3160

- moved cursor from `document` to `canvas`. This way it won't ever affect DOM outside the component, but it'll also fix cases where we forget to update the cursor when mousing over the UI, so it's a win-win.
- moved the cursor updating to helper — not sure if the extra function will meaningfully impact perf in tight loops (such as `pointermove` events), but it doesn't look like it

issue_context.title: Cursor does not reset
issue_context.body: This is a bug more noticeable for embedded Excalidraw. If I click to draw with a pencil and I move out of the Excalidraw screen with my cursor, the cursor does not reset to a pointer (and remains as +).

review_comments: From testing it doesn't seem like we need it, but there may be some edge cases. If so, we'll move it up to `App.tsx`.
sadly, that's illegal in JS: it'd try to assign `cursor` to `undefined` in case `canvas` was null
